definitions.explanation: Starting something again after it has stopped. Used for machines, engines, systems, projects, or activities that are resumed after a pause or shutdown.

examples.japanese: ⟦エンジン→エンジン：03835_enjin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{再始動|さいしどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{試|こころ}みた→試みる：01943_kokoromiru⟧。
examples.english: I attempted to restart the engine.

examples.japanese: ⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{再始動|さいしどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{数分|すうふん}→数分：21623_suufun⟧⟦かかります→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: Restarting the system takes a few minutes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧ライン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{停止|ていし}した→停止する：20992_teishisuru⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{済|す}ませて→済む：01950_sumu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{再始動|さいしどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手順|てじゅん}→手順：05452_tejun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: After the factory production line stopped, they completed safety checks before beginning the restart procedure.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{再|さい}→再〜：03953_sai⟧ (again, re-) and ⟦{始動|しどう}→始動：12247_shidou⟧ (starting, activation). Often used in technical, industrial, and IT contexts. Can also be used as a verb with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再始動|さいしどう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to restart
- {再始動|さいしどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{試|こころ}みる→試みる：01943_kokoromiru⟧: to attempt a restart
- {再始動|さいしどう}⟦{手順|てじゅん}→手順：05452_tejun⟧: restart procedure
- {再始動|さいしどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧: the restart takes time

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{再起動|さいきどう}→再起動：09222_saikidou⟧: reboot, restart — often used for computers and electronic devices
- ⟦{再開|さいかい}→再開：05219_saikai⟧: resumption, reopening — broader term for resuming activities, business, or events
- ⟦{始動|しどう}→始動：12247_shidou⟧: starting, activation — the initial start, without the "again" nuance
